sections.label: Lease Buyback Scheme retirement adequacy
sections.summary: The scheme lets elderly flat owners sell part of their HDB lease to the Government and join CPF LIFE to improve retirement adequacy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The scheme aims to improve the retirement adequacy of elderly flat owners by enabling them to sell a portion of the lease of their HDB flat to the Government and join CPF LIFE.

sections.label: Lease Buyback Scheme bonus increase
sections.summary: In April 2020 the maximum LBS bonus rose 50% across flat types, to $30,000, $15,000 and $7,500.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In April 2020, the maximum LBS bonus was increased by 50% across all flat types, to $30,000 for 3-room and smaller flats, $15,000 for 4-room flats and $7,500 for 5-room and bigger flats.

sections.label: Home for Life lease requirement
sections.summary: The response states this will not be allowed and cites the Home for Life requirement that the retained lease last to at least age 95.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Our response is, we will not allow that to happen.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And secondly, that is precisely why we have a Home for Life requirement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, you have to choose the right lease to retain, but that must take you to at least age 95.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And we will make sure that for seniors who outlive their lease, that with the necessary top-ups and support, we will be able to provide them with housing.

sections.label: Growing numbers of scheme participants
sections.summary: Numbers have grown over the years due to greater awareness, understanding of details, and adjustments made to the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The numbers have been growing over the years, partly, due to greater awareness of the scheme, greater understanding of its details, but also because of the adjustments that have been made to the scheme over the years.

sections.label: Ageing-in-place and right-sizing options
sections.summary: Some view ageing-in-place as moving to a smaller flat in the same community, so the Silver Housing Bonus helps those who right-size.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But others view ageing-in-place as ageing in a more manageable, smaller flat, in the same community, in the same estate, familiar with their neighbours, familiar with the shopkeepers and the surroundings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That is why, in addition to the Lease Buyback Scheme, we also have the Silver Housing Bonus to help those who right-size.

sections.label: HDB personalised options sessions
sections.summary: At these sessions HDB explains personalised information on options, such as qualifying lease lengths and indicative proceeds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: At these sessions, HDB will explain personalised information on their options – so, very specific to the senior, such as the different lease lengths they qualify for and the indicative proceeds for these options.
